verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions transferring a call to a human. A developer could plausibly build escalation themselves: function calling lets the agent trigger actions that your application executes mid-call, and the Twilio bridge leaves your server in control of the call leg. The documented multi-agent handoff is agent-to-agent, not to a human. Missing for 10: any documented warm or blind transfer to a human, a first-party transfer function or telephony transfer primitive, documented passing of conversation context or summary to the human, and hands-on corroboration.
